caption: The drawing depicts a tall grandfather clock with a wooden case, primarily colored in shades of brown with darker and lighter accents that highlight its decorative panels and contours. The clock has a rectangular lower cabinet with a large oval inlay or design near the base, a middle section with an elongated oval panel design on the door, and a distinct upper section where the clock face is housed. The clock face itself is white with black Arabic numerals and black clock hands, set within a square frame, and above the face is an arch featuring a gold decorative motif. The top of the clock case is ornate, with a curved, scroll-like design and topped by three gold finials. The background is plain and off-white, allowing the clock to stand out as the sole object in the composition. The artist's signature "G. Capelli" is visible in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Grandfather Clock
